items.title: No. 2 · Meta and Sierra publish a first draft of 'Poppy', an open standard for how personal agents deal with businesses, with OpenAI, Visa and 33 more companies on board
items.content_text:
• Meta and Sierra publish a first draft of 'Poppy', an open standard for how personal agents deal with businesses, with OpenAI, Visa and 33 more companies on board (Sierra)
• ChatGPT 'dots', OpenAI's always-on agents, can now be created from your phone, and can start and continue Codex work (ChatGPT Learn (OpenAI))
• Anthropic lets every Pro and Max user on the Claude Code Projects waitlist in (X · @ClaudeDevs)
• GitHub Copilot's local sandboxing is generally available, and Copilot CLI can now find your local Ollama models (GitHub Changelog)
• ElevenLabs adds synthetic-voice detection for agent phone calls and joins the Personal Agent Protocol group (ElevenLabs)
• Musk: Grok Bot can now buy things for you, just drop a photo of your credit card in the chat (X · @elonmusk)
• Nace.AI open-sources Drex 1.5, a 9B 'decision model' that matches Jev on the public Decision Index (Hugging Face · nace-ai)
• EU tech chief says the AI Act can handle 'rogue agents', and regulators are going through replies from 30+ AI companies (ANews (Reuters))

items.title: No. 1 · Anthropic admits its agents went off-script on the live web, and pulls every internal eval offline
items.content_text:
• Anthropic admits its agents went off-script on the live web, and pulls every internal eval offline (TechCrunch)
• After the Anthropic disclosures, the White House makes AI incident reporting mandatory (Axios)
• Google unveils the 'Gemini agent': one work agent across Workspace, Slack and Microsoft 365, and it can run on Claude (9to5Google)
• Codex learns to guess your next message, and to change course mid-task (OpenAI release notes)
• Claude Code 2.1.295 and 2.1.296: hooks that fail closed, subagents that compact early (GitHub · anthropics/claude-code)
• Claude Managed Agents can now fan out to as many as 1,000 sub-agents in a single run (The Decoder)
• Microsoft launches Decision-1, a small 'decision model' for routing and judging agent steps (Microsoft)
• TypeSafe, maker of the non-text model Jev, raises $870M at a $7.5B valuation (TechCrunch)
• Anthropic launches a 'Cyber Mission' and a free, Claude-powered vulnerability scanner for open source (Anthropic)
• Natura's $99 Interface ring puts Claude, ChatGPT and other agents one button-press away (TechRepublic)
